summary: Four-person snowshoe party caught in an avalanche on Marble Quarry Road near Marble (Yule Creek area) while heading to a cabin; Nathaniel Smith, 27, of Colorado Springs, was buried and killed along with his two dogs (Kenai and Bea); the three companions survived. Limited search Friday evening was halted for hazards; body found ~11:34 a.m. Saturday.
location: Marble Quarry Road near Marble (Yule Creek area)
responding_agency: West Elk Search and Rescue, Carbondale EMS, Colorado Avalanche Center
